discovery_disclosure: The rational center and coarse interval behavior were selected during reconnaissance before this registration. This contract preregisters the formal exact certificate, replay, mutation, scope, and stopping decisions; it is not a claim of a blinded experiment.

declared_scope.kind: one closed rational box in one normalized uniform-parent cell

success_conditions: the three authenticated residual equations vanish exactly at the rational center
all 70 normalized parent brackets have exact sign-definite direct-monomial interval enclosures on the full closed box
the fixed 3-by-3 residual Jacobian minor has an exact sign-definite direct-monomial interval enclosure on the full closed box
the independent verifier reconstructs the source equations, 70 parent brackets, Jacobian minor, intervals, semantic digest, and all 18 boundary faces without importing the producer
every declared hostile mutation is rejected
null_conditions: the center is not an exact triple zero
some parent bracket interval contains zero
the fixed projection minor interval contains zero
independent replay or a hostile mutation test fails
finite_acceptance_contract.fail_closed_policy: No adaptive radius reduction, pivot substitution, numerical tolerance, or orbit enlargement is allowed in the formal run.
finite_acceptance_contract.resource_ceiling: 300 wall-clock seconds and 1 GiB resident memory for each producer or verifier run

proof_consequence_if_accepted: Every connected component of the named triple-zero set restricted to the declared closed box meets one of its 18 boundary faces; the component through the center is nonvacuous.
non_consequences: no component is proved to reach a genuine parent wall or parent infinity
no full parent cell is covered
no second representative and no S8 orbit is covered
the independent pair H_c^1 obligation is unchanged
